edit: This is the only file Lizzy needs to edit to add a meeting or change an agenda. It is loaded by the staff API after sign-in. It is not a public page. Live ticks, notes and extra actions are stored separately and are not written back into this file. Copy an existing meeting, keep ids unique, and leave status out of the seed: every item starts open.

fields.meetings: Array of meetings. List order is not the screen order. The screen puts upcoming meetings first, then confirmed meetings with no clock time, then tentative meetings.
fields.id: Unique slug, lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens. Used to save live ticks. Do not rename an id once a meeting has been used, or saved ticks will no longer match.
fields.title: Name shown on the list and the agenda.
fields.party: The key party, shown under the title.
fields.purpose: One or two sentences. Leave blank when purpose_tbc is true.
fields.purpose_tbc: true shows a Purpose TBC badge and hides a blank purpose.
fields.tentative: true shows a Tentative badge and sorts the meeting after confirmed ones.
fields.when.label: Short schedule line, such as Weekdays or Time TBC.
fields.when.duration_minutes: Planned length. Null if it is not set.
fields.when.allow_minutes: Longer length the chair will allow. Null if it is not set.
fields.when.starts_at: ISO 8601 start, or null when the clock time is not set.
fields.when.timezone: Europe/London unless the meeting is elsewhere.
fields.when.note: One line under the schedule. Use it for arrangements such as WhatsApp, without adding a phone number.
fields.sections: Time-boxed blocks, in the order they should be taken.
fields.sections.minutes: Integer minutes for that block, or null when the time box is not set.
fields.sections.items: Agenda lines. id is unique inside the meeting. owner is a name. detail is one or two sentences. Do not put live status or notes here.
fields.actions: Actions arising that belong to the agenda. id is unique inside the meeting. text and owner are required. Done ticks are stored with the live progress, not here.
